description: Document and test scalar override precedence and collection/reference merge behavior across CLI flags, project metadata, and platform/discovery defaults.

description: Introduce `oxvba explain` or equivalent `host-check` expansion that reports discovered lane, startup, effective runtime/profile/policy, and effective reference order for a target.
